name: Switched
source:
Charlotte, A young high school student, finds herself in a weird situation. She was gifted magical girl powers! She's far from fighting for love and justice though...

[from [url=https://aileetoilee.itch.io/switched-gamejam]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻的高中生夏洛特，陷入了奇怪的处境。她竟然获得了魔法少女的力量！可她所做的，却远不是为了爱与正义而战…

[摘自[url=https://aileetoilee.itch.io/switched-gamejam]itch.io[/url]]
